claims.explanation: Selective killing by NVP-AUY922 is best explained by dependence on HSP90 client oncoproteins and the PI3K/Akt pathway: activating PIK3CA/PTEN and EGFR/MET/KIT/NRAS alterations sensitize, while KRAS mutation and high HSPA1A (Hsp70) protect. Chromatin-remodeling mutations (SMARCA4, ARID1A) and CDKN2A/FBXW7 loss also correlate with response, but are lower-confidence.
